profile_text.body:
NXAI is a for-profit AI startup founded in 2023 and headquartered in Linz, Austria. On its own site it describes itself as a frontier AI lab building systems intended to master any cognitive task, and says its proprietary xLSTM memory architectures enable state tracking and outperform the currently dominant Transformer architectures. The company names Prof. Dr. Sepp Hochreiter as its chief scientist and co-founder, and says it works closely with JKU Linz and other research institutions worldwide.

The site says NXAI is building specialized world models based on time-series analysis, named TiRex, using new memory architectures, and describes 50x impact across industrial systems in edge, embedded, and forecasting applications. It states that it deploys its xLSTM models in a cloud environment but focuses on edge applications, supported by its own edge lab, and that it holds top positions on globally recognized leaderboards. It also says it intends to develop larger world models built on neural memory hierarchies and memory routing, with robotics as a major application area.
